{%- comment -%}
  Plain-Markdown site summary for AI crawlers. Follows selling mode
  (site.selling, _plugins/selling_mode.rb): the shop, returns, and "for sale"
  parts only appear while at least one of my own items is for sale. Amazon deals
  list no price while amazon_show_prices is false (Associates rules).
{%- endcomment -%}
{%- assign for_sale = site.products | where: "type", "sale" | where: "status", "available" | sort: "date" | reverse -%}
{%- assign today = site.time | date: "%Y-%m-%d" -%}
{%- assign deals = site.products | where: "type", "affiliate" | sort: "date" | reverse -%}
# {{ site.title }}

> {{ site.description | strip_html | strip_newlines | strip }}

{% if site.selling %}{{ site.title }} is run by {{ site.author }}. It has two parts: used tech that {{ site.author }} sells directly (checkout through AnyCart and Stripe), and affiliate deals at other stores.{% else %}{{ site.title }} is run by {{ site.author }}. It lists tech deals at other stores, each found and checked by hand.{% endif %} {{ site.affiliate_disclosure | strip }}

- Website: {{ site.url }}/
{%- if site.data.company.email and site.data.company.email != "" %}
- Email: {{ site.data.company.email }}
{%- endif %}

## Pages

{% if site.selling -%}
- [Home]({{ '/' | absolute_url }}): newest items for sale and featured deals
- [For sale]({{ '/shop/' | absolute_url }}): used tech sold directly, with condition notes
{%- else -%}
- [Home]({{ '/' | absolute_url }}): featured deals
{%- endif %}
- [Deals]({{ '/deals/' | absolute_url }}): affiliate deals at other stores
{%- for c in site.data.categories %}{% assign cat_live = 0 %}{% for d in deals %}{% if d.category == c.name %}{% if d.expires %}{% assign exp = d.expires | date: "%Y-%m-%d" %}{% if exp < today %}{% continue %}{% endif %}{% endif %}{% assign cat_live = cat_live | plus: 1 %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{% if cat_live > 0 %}
  - [{{ c.name }} deals]({{ '/deals/' | append: c.slug | append: '/' | absolute_url }})
{%- endif %}{% endfor %}

- [Returns & shipping]({{ '/returns/' | absolute_url }}): shipping times, returns, and refunds
{%- endif %}
- [Affiliate disclosure]({{ '/disclosure/' | absolute_url }}): how affiliate links on the Deals page work
- [Terms]({{ '/terms/' | absolute_url }}) and [Privacy]({{ '/privacy/' | absolute_url }})
